rationale: Mining/quarrying output (mining of hard coal) is a physical raw commodity traded internationally and across regions; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Coal mining sits in the non-renewable-resource sector the Constitution (art. 313) reserves to state administration, and the mining cadastre through which concessions are requested has been closed since 2018 — so no province can acquire this industry by private application, let alone by investment.

rationale: Mining/quarrying output (mining of lignite) is a physical raw commodity traded internationally and across regions; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Lignite mining is governed by the same art. 313 strategic-sector regime and the same closed cadastre as hard coal: the right to mine is granted or withheld nationally, not competed for locally.

rationale: Mining/quarrying output (extraction of crude petroleum) is a physical raw commodity traded internationally and across regions; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Ecuador's hydrocarbons are inalienable state property (Constitution arts. 1 and 408) and crude production is overwhelmingly Petroecuador's; private participation exists only through service contracts on nationally tendered blocks. A province cannot enter oil extraction — it can only host a block the state assigns.

rationale: Mining/quarrying output (extraction of natural gas) is a physical raw commodity traded internationally and across regions; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Natural-gas extraction (the Amistad field and associated gas) runs on the same state-ownership and block-award regime as crude: Petroecuador operates and the acreage is allocated nationally.

rationale: Mining/quarrying output (mining of iron ores) is a physical raw commodity traded internationally and across regions; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Metallic mining is an art. 313 strategic sector; the large projects (Mirador, Fruta del Norte) advance as nationally negotiated concession and exploitation contracts, and with the cadastre closed since 2018 no new concession can even be requested. Private capital operates, but the right to operate is state-allocated.

isic_name: Mining of uranium and thorium ores
rationale: Mining/quarrying output (mining of uranium and thorium ores) is a physical raw commodity traded internationally and across regions; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Uranium and thorium are radioactive materials under exclusive state control; there is no lawful private-entry channel into their extraction in Ecuador.

isic_name: Mining of other non-ferrous metal ores
rationale: Mining/quarrying output (mining of other non-ferrous metal ores) is a physical raw commodity traded internationally and across regions; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Other non-ferrous metal ore mining shares the art. 313 strategic-sector regime and the closed mining cadastre: where it happens is a national concession decision layered on top of geology.

isic_name: Quarrying of stone, sand and clay
rationale: Mining/quarrying output (quarrying of stone, sand and clay) is a physical raw commodity traded internationally and across regions; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Non-metallic quarrying and extraction support (Quarrying of stone, sand and clay) operates in Ecuador as ordinary private business — small concessions and libre aprovechamiento for construction materials, and competitively contracted oilfield and mining services. Entry is by concession application and environmental licence, not by ministry siting.

isic_name: Electric power generation, transmission and distribution
section_name: Electricity, gas, steam and air conditioning supply
rationale: Bundles bulk generation/transmission with local distribution. Power is overwhelmingly consumed domestically (non-tradable Atlas; only minor cross-border trade). Generation feeds a multi-province national grid, so generating provinces effectively export power (tradable regional/economic-base), though final distribution is a local utility. Divergence; mixed on both sides given the bundle.
rationale_entry: Electricity is an art. 313 strategic sector, and this class bundles two non-market halves: CELEC generation, whose plants are sited by the national Plan Maestro de Electricidad and built as public investment, and the CNEL and municipal distribution utilities, which are regulated local monopolies. Private generation exists only via state-awarded permits and PPAs with the single buyer. mixed_entry because the generation half is a state siting decision while the distribution half is a franchised network monopoly — neither is open entry, but they are different mechanisms.

isic_name: Manufacture of gas; distribution of gaseous fuels through mains
section_name: Electricity, gas, steam and air conditioning supply
rationale: Gas can be a tradable commodity, but this class centres on distribution through local mains -- a place-bound utility network; non-tradable Atlas and largely non-tradable regionally, with the production/bulk-supply component straddling. Mixed.
rationale_entry: Piped gas barely exists in Ecuador: LPG is imported and wholesaled by Petroecuador at a controlled price, and any mains network would be a state energy-sector project. mixed_entry because the class also covers gas manufacture, an ordinary industrial activity, alongside mains distribution, a monopoly network.

section_name: Electricity, gas, steam and air conditioning supply
rationale: District steam/heat/air-conditioning cannot be transported far and serves customers physically connected to the local network; non-tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: The Ecuadorian content of this class is ice manufacture for the fishing ports and the food trade, plus commercial chilled-water and air-conditioning plant — ordinary private businesses. District heating and cooling networks, the utility-shaped part of the class, effectively do not exist here.

section_name: Water supply; sewerage, waste management and remediation activities
rationale: Piped water is a place-bound local utility serving connected resident customers; non-tradable under both definitions (anchor).
rationale_entry: Potable water is an exclusive canton competence under COOTAD art. 55 and the Constitution forbids its privatisation (art. 318); provincial presence is a municipal water utility. A private entrant cannot cause a water utility to appear.

section_name: Water supply; sewerage, waste management and remediation activities
rationale: Sewerage networks serve the local connected population; non-tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Sewerage is the same exclusive canton competence as potable water and is delivered by the municipal utility. The private fringe — septic-tank emptying — is a small local service, not the industry the class describes.

section_name: Water supply; sewerage, waste management and remediation activities
rationale: Municipal waste collection is a local service for resident customers (non-tradable Atlas); slightly mixed regionally because some collectors operate across municipal/provincial boundaries.
rationale_entry: Solid-waste collection is an exclusive canton competence under COOTAD, executed by a municipal company or by a municipally awarded concession (Consorcio Puerto Limpio in Guayaquil). mixed_entry because the class also holds genuinely private recyclable and scrap collection, which any entrant may run.

section_name: Water supply; sewerage, waste management and remediation activities
rationale: Specialized hazardous-waste collection can serve a multi-province catchment of industrial clients, so it straddles the regional line, but it is not an internationally traded output (non-tradable Atlas); mixed.
rationale_entry: Hazardous-waste collection is a licensed private industry: MAATE-registered gestores ambientales (Incinerox, Gadere, Hazwat) compete for oilfield, hospital and industrial waste. The environmental licence is a competence requirement, not an allocation — new gestores are registered routinely.

isic_name: Treatment and disposal of non-hazardous waste
section_name: Water supply; sewerage, waste management and remediation activities
rationale: Manual Ecuador review override (2026-08-17): under COOTAD, solid-waste management is an exclusive canton-level municipal competence, and landfills such as El Inga (Quito) or Las Iguanas (Guayaquil) serve their own canton/metro — household waste does not cross province lines. Non-tradable under both definitions; the multi-province catchment assumed by the original call does not exist in Ecuador.
rationale_entry: Non-hazardous treatment and disposal means the municipal landfill (El Inga, Las Iguanas): sited, financed and operated on the canton's decision as part of its exclusive waste competence.

isic_name: Treatment and disposal of hazardous waste
section_name: Water supply; sewerage, waste management and remediation activities
rationale: Specialized hazardous-waste treatment is concentrated in a few regional/national facilities serving clients across provinces (tradable regional) but is not internationally traded (non-tradable Atlas). Divergence; mixed.
rationale_entry: Hazardous-waste treatment is the licensed-gestor market again, on the treatment rather than the collection side: private incineration, encapsulation and co-processing plants entered by investment plus a MAATE licence.

section_name: Water supply; sewerage, waste management and remediation activities
rationale: Materials recovery produces scrap/recyclate sold as a commodity into national and international markets -- the output is genuinely traded, so tradable under both. Mixed under Atlas because the activity is part sorting/processing service, part commodity.
rationale_entry: Materials recovery is one of Ecuador's most atomised private industries — scrap yards, recyclers, plastic and metal reprocessors — entered with a yard and a truck.

isic_name: Remediation activities and other waste management services
section_name: Water supply; sewerage, waste management and remediation activities
rationale: Project-based environmental remediation delivered at the client site; specialized firms serve clients across a region (tradable regional) but the output is not an export (non-tradable Atlas). Divergence; mixed.

rationale: Interurban passenger rail connects provinces/regions; a region-connecting transport service, tradable under both.
rationale_entry: Interurban passenger rail in Ecuador is a state asset: the network is public, Ferrocarriles del Ecuador EP was ordered liquidated in 2020, and the surviving tourist operations run on state track. Whether a province has rail is a national infrastructure decision made decades ago.

rationale: Freight rail hauls goods across regions and to ports/borders; transport-and-logistics service, tradable under both.
rationale_entry: Freight rail runs on the same publicly owned and largely dormant network; there is no private-entry channel and no open-access regime through which an entrant could start hauling.

isic_name: Urban and suburban passenger land transport
rationale: City/suburban buses and metros serve local commuters within the locality; non-tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Urban bus service is allocated: a canton's transit authority grants route permits from an administratively fixed pool, and the trunk systems (Trolebus, Metrovia, Metro de Quito) are municipal undertakings. An entrant with capital and buses still cannot start a city line.

rationale: Mixed category spanning interurban/long-distance coaches (region-connecting, tradable) and local taxis/charters (local); leans tradable on the interurban share. Mixed under both.
rationale_entry: Both halves of this class are permit-allocated rather than open: interprovincial coach routes are ANT operating concessions granted from a controlled pool, and taxi permits are capped canton by canton. The operators are private cooperatives, which is why mixed_entry is set, but a province that wants more of this industry cannot buy its way in — it has to be granted routes.

rationale: Road freight/trucking carries goods across provinces and to borders; transport-and-logistics service, tradable under both.
rationale_entry: Road freight is Ecuador's most atomised transport market: thousands of private carriers and owner-operators, with ANT registration as conduct regulation. Capacity follows cargo.

rationale: Pipelines move oil/gas across regions to ports and export terminals (region- and export-serving); tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Pipeline transport is two national trunk lines — the state's SOTE, operated by Petroecuador, and OCP, built under a state contract and since reverted to the state — plus the poliductos. A province's presence is a pump station on a nationally routed line, and hydrocarbon transport is itself an art. 313 strategic sector.

isic_name: Sea and coastal passenger water transport
rationale: Maritime passenger transport connects ports across regions and internationally; tradable under both.
rationale_entry: Sea and coastal passenger service — Galapagos inter-island boats, coastal ferries, tourist cruising — is run by private operators and cooperatives under DIRNEA and Mintur permits. Entry is by buying a vessel.

isic_name: Sea and coastal freight water transport
rationale: Maritime freight is core international trade logistics; tradable under both.
rationale_entry: Coastal and sea freight is private shipping: entry is a vessel and a flag registration, and Ecuadorian cabotage operators compete for banana, fuel and container coastwise traffic.

rationale: Inland/river passenger transport (relevant in the Amazon/coast) connects communities across a region; leans tradable but some routes are local. Mixed.
rationale_entry: Amazonian river passenger service is provided by private and community operators — canoe and lancha businesses entered with a boat and a licence.

rationale: Inland/river freight moves goods across a region toward markets/ports; tradable under both. Mixed under Atlas given mostly domestic reach.
rationale_entry: River freight is likewise a private business, entered with a barge or a lancha; nothing allocates the right to carry.

rationale: Airlines connect provinces and countries and carry inbound tourists; tradable under both.
rationale_entry: Airlines are private firms (Avianca Ecuador, Latam, Aeroregional, Equair). DGAC and CNAC certification is a safety and fitness licence and Ecuador's domestic routes are not slot-constrained, so an entrant can and does add service; a province with an airport can attract flights commercially.

rationale: Air cargo is international/inter-regional trade logistics; tradable under both.
rationale_entry: Air freight — flower and seafood charter out of Quito, Latacunga and Guayaquil — is a private carrier market with ordinary certification.

rationale: Storage/warehousing is not itself an exported service (non-tradable Atlas), but distribution warehouses, grain silos and cold stores serve a multi-province catchment (tradable regional/economic-base). Canonical Atlas-vs-regional divergence (anchor).
rationale_entry: Warehousing is entered by building a shed: private bodegas, cold stores and customs warehouses. SENAE authorisation for bonded space is a compliance step, not a cap.

isic_name: Service activities incidental to land transportation
rationale: Terminal/freight-handling support to land transport supports inter-regional and trade flows; tradable under both. Mixed under Atlas as some operations are local.
rationale_entry: The bulk of this class in Ecuador is private: parking, towing, weighbridges and freight-terminal services. Intercity bus terminals are municipal, but they are a minority of the establishments and the private services around them are freely entered.

isic_name: Service activities incidental to water transportation
rationale: Port/harbour and shipping support services serve international maritime trade; tradable under both.
rationale_entry: The class's establishment mass is private and contestable — shipping agencies, stevedores, pilots, ships' chandlers, tug operators — and those firms are formed freely. mixed_entry because it also contains port and container-terminal operation, where a deep-water facility exists only by a state concession (DP World Posorja, Contecon Guayaquil) awarded nationally.

isic_name: Service activities incidental to air transportation
rationale: Airport ground services and air-traffic support serve inter-regional/international flights; tradable under both.
rationale_entry: Ground handling, catering, fuelling and aviation services are ordinary private businesses at any airport. mixed_entry because airport operation itself is a concession (Quiport in Quito, TAGSA in Guayaquil) granted by a public authority, so the largest single unit in the class is allocated rather than entered.

rationale: Loading/unloading at ports, airports and terminals serves trade flows; tradable under both. Mixed under Atlas where handling is for local transport.
rationale_entry: Cargo handling is a private stevedoring and terminal-services market; firms enter with equipment and labour.

rationale: Freight forwarding, customs brokerage and logistics coordination directly serve cross-border/inter-regional trade; tradable under both. Mixed under Atlas given some local dispatch.
rationale_entry: Freight forwarding and customs broking are private professional businesses; the SENAE agent licence is a qualification, not a quota.

rationale: Manual Ecuador review override (2026-08-17): the universal-service operator (Correos del Ecuador, ordered liquidated in 2020) delivers mail to each province's own residents, so hosting post offices brings no external revenue. The genuinely inter-provincial parcel and courier business (Servientrega et al.) sits in 5320, not here. Non-tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Postal activity is the universal-service obligation: Correos del Ecuador EP held it, was ordered liquidated in 2020, and its vestigial successor still holds it. A post office appears where the state decides to serve, not where an entrant invests; the contestable parcel business sits in 5320.

rationale: Express/courier networks (incl. international parcels) are trade-and-logistics services serving clients across regions and borders; tradable under both. Mixed under Atlas where last-mile delivery is local.
rationale_entry: Courier service is fully contestable — Servientrega, Laar, Urbano, DHL and hundreds of local couriers — entered with vehicles and a postal registration that is granted on request.

rationale: Hotels serve visitors travelling from other provinces and abroad -- exported tourism services; tradable under both (anchor).
rationale_entry: Accommodation and food service (Short term accommodation activities) is the archetypal contestable business — private capital, a Mintur registration and a municipal permit. A province that wants more of it can attract it with investment.

isic_name: Camping grounds, recreational vehicle parks and trailer parks
rationale: Camping/RV/trailer parks serve travelling tourists/visitors; tradable tourism service under both. Mixed under Atlas as some sites serve local/regional weekenders.
rationale_entry: Accommodation and food service (Camping grounds, recreational vehicle parks and trailer parks) is the archetypal contestable business — private capital, a Mintur registration and a municipal permit. A province that wants more of it can attract it with investment.

rationale: Other lodging (hostels, workers'/student residences) partly serves visitors (tourism, tradable) and partly longer-stay local users; leans tradable, mixed under Atlas.
rationale_entry: Accommodation and food service (Other accommodation) is the archetypal contestable business — private capital, a Mintur registration and a municipal permit. A province that wants more of it can attract it with investment.

isic_name: Restaurants and mobile food service activities
rationale: Restaurants mainly serve local diners (non-tradable), though in tourist areas a meaningful share serves visitors; flagged mixed under both with low confidence given the tourism component.
rationale_entry: Accommodation and food service (Restaurants and mobile food service activities) is the archetypal contestable business — private capital, a Mintur registration and a municipal permit. A province that wants more of it can attract it with investment.

rationale: Catering is contracted for local/regional events; mostly local but can serve clients across a region -- mixed under both, leaning local.
rationale_entry: Accommodation and food service (Event catering) is the archetypal contestable business — private capital, a Mintur registration and a municipal permit. A province that wants more of it can attract it with investment.

rationale: Contract/institutional food service (canteens, concessions) serves on-site clients; some operators run multi-site regional contracts -- mixed, leaning local.
rationale_entry: Accommodation and food service (Other food service activities) is the archetypal contestable business — private capital, a Mintur registration and a municipal permit. A province that wants more of it can attract it with investment.

rationale: Bars/cafes serve walk-in local patrons; non-tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Accommodation and food service (Beverage serving activities) is the archetypal contestable business — private capital, a Mintur registration and a municipal permit. A province that wants more of it can attract it with investment.

rationale: Information/communication service (book publishing) is delivered digitally/at a distance to clients in other provinces and abroad; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Information and content services (Book publishing) need no licence and no allocated frequency: a studio, a newsroom or a software team is set up with people and equipment, and the output travels over networks the firm does not have to own.

rationale: Cinemas sell admissions to a local/regional audience that physically attends; unlike film production/distribution, exhibition is place-bound. Non-tradable under both; mixed regionally as multiplexes draw a wider area. Diverges from the rest of section J.
rationale_entry: Cinema exhibition is a private chain-and-independent business (Supercines, Cinemark, provincial single screens) entered by building or leasing a screen.

isic_name: Sound recording and music publishing activities
rationale: Information/communication service (sound recording and music publishing activities) is delivered digitally/at a distance to clients in other provinces and abroad; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Information and content services (Sound recording and music publishing activities) need no licence and no allocated frequency: a studio, a newsroom or a software team is set up with people and equipment, and the output travels over networks the firm does not have to own.

rationale: Radio content can be syndicated and reaches audiences beyond the locality (national networks), so it leans tradable, but many stations serve a purely local market -- mixed under both.
rationale_entry: A radio station cannot be started with capital alone: it needs an ARCOTEL frequency concession, and the radio spectrum is an art. 313 strategic sector whose broadcast frequencies are a finite pool distributed by administrative competition and reserved in thirds (public, private, community) by the Ley Organica de Comunicacion. mixed_entry because the class holds both repeater nodes of Quito and Guayaquil national networks and genuinely local stations holding their own concession.

rationale: TV programming/broadcasting produces content distributed to national/multi-region audiences and can be licensed/exported; tradable under both. Mixed under Atlas given the local-station component.
rationale_entry: Television broadcasting runs on the same ARCOTEL frequency-concession regime as radio, with an even scarcer pool and a national-network structure (Ecuavisa, Teleamazonas, TC, and the state channel) whose provincial presence is mostly repeater and news-bureau nodes. mixed_entry for the same reason as 6010: a minority of provincial channels hold their own concession.

rationale: Information/communication service (wired telecommunications activities) is delivered digitally/at a distance to clients in other provinces and abroad; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Fixed telecommunications is an art. 313 strategic sector: service requires an ARCOTEL title, the incumbent is the state's CNT EP, and the private operators (Claro fixed, Netlife, Grupo TVCable) are national concessionaires. A province's establishments are their local exchanges and commercial offices, not local capability.

rationale: Information/communication service (wireless telecommunications activities) is delivered digitally/at a distance to clients in other provinces and abroad; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Mobile service is three national operators holding spectrum concessions from ARCOTEL (Claro, Movistar, CNT). Spectrum is constitutionally strategic and finite; no province can add a mobile operator, and its booked establishments are cell sites and branded stores of a national decision.

rationale: Information/communication service (satellite telecommunications activities) is delivered digitally/at a distance to clients in other provinces and abroad; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Satellite service requires an ARCOTEL title and, in practice, means a handful of national gateway and direct-to-home operators; a provincial establishment is a teleport or a reseller office of a nationally licensed operator.

rationale: Information/communication service (other telecommunications activities) is delivered digitally/at a distance to clients in other provinces and abroad; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Ecuador's small-ISP sector is genuinely contestable: hundreds of local value-added-service permit holders and rural WISPs, granted on application, are a real provincial business built by local entrepreneurs. mixed_entry because the class also holds satellite tracking, telemetry and national reseller operations that are licensed concessions rather than local ventures.

rationale: Information/communication service (computer programming activities) is delivered digitally/at a distance to clients in other provinces and abroad; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Information and content services (Computer programming activities) need no licence and no allocated frequency: a studio, a newsroom or a software team is set up with people and equipment, and the output travels over networks the firm does not have to own.

rationale: Information/communication service (news agency activities) is delivered digitally/at a distance to clients in other provinces and abroad; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Information and content services (News agency activities) need no licence and no allocated frequency: a studio, a newsroom or a software team is set up with people and equipment, and the output travels over networks the firm does not have to own.

rationale: Information/communication service (other information service activities n.e.c.) is delivered digitally/at a distance to clients in other provinces and abroad; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Information and content services (Other information service activities n.e.c.) need no licence and no allocated frequency: a studio, a newsroom or a software team is set up with people and equipment, and the output travels over networks the firm does not have to own.

rationale: Central banking is a national monetary-authority function, not a market service sold to customers; not tradable as an export or across provinces in the economic-base sense. Non-tradable under both; mixed/low confidence as it is sui generis. Diverges from the rest of section K.
rationale_entry: Central banking is one institution, the Banco Central del Ecuador, established by the Constitution. There is no entry channel of any kind.

rationale: Financial/insurance service (other monetary intermediation) is delivered at a distance to clients beyond the locality and across borders; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Deposit-taking requires a charter: banks are authorised by the Superintendencia de Bancos, which has granted essentially no new bank in years, and provincial presence is the branch network of national banks (Pichincha, Guayaquil, Pacifico, Produbanco). mixed_entry because the class also holds the SEPS-supervised savings-and-credit cooperatives, which are locally founded and locally owned and are a genuine provincial institution — though the SEPS has been consolidating rather than chartering them.

rationale: Financial/insurance service (activities of holding companies) is delivered at a distance to clients beyond the locality and across borders; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: A holding company is constituted by ordinary private act at the Superintendencia de Companias. Its provincial location is a corporate-domicile choice, freely made, and largely an HQ artifact.

isic_name: Trusts, funds and similar financial entities
rationale: Financial/insurance service (trusts, funds and similar financial entities) is delivered at a distance to clients beyond the locality and across borders; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Trusts and investment funds are not entered — they are constituted, by the nationally licensed administradoras de fondos y fideicomisos domiciled in Quito and Guayaquil. A vehicle booked in a province is a paper node of a national licence, and the class has almost no employment by ISIC's own definition.

rationale: Financial/insurance service (financial leasing) is delivered at a distance to clients beyond the locality and across borders; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Financial leasing requires authorisation from the Superintendencia de Bancos and is in practice conducted by the leasing arms of the national banks; a provincial office is a branch of that charter.

rationale: Financial/insurance service (other credit granting) is delivered at a distance to clients beyond the locality and across borders; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Non-deposit credit granting still needs authorisation under the Codigo Organico Monetario y Financiero, and its Ecuadorian mass is the store-card and consumer-credit arms of national retail and banking groups plus regulated pawnbroking. Provincial presence is a lending desk inside a national network.

isic_name: Other financial service activities, except insurance and pension funding activities, n.e.c.
rationale: Financial/insurance service (other financial service activities, except insurance and pension funding activities, n.e.c.) is delivered at a distance to clients beyond the locality and across borders; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Factoring, own-account investment and venture capital are activities an ordinary company may carry out without a financial charter, and small private investment vehicles are formed freely. mixed_entry because the regulated factoring and derivative-writing side is done by chartered financial institutions.

rationale: Financial/insurance service (life insurance) is delivered at a distance to clients beyond the locality and across borders; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Life insurers are chartered by the supervisor and operate nationally; underwriting capital, reserves and product approval are national requirements. What a province holds is an agency or branch of a national carrier.

rationale: Financial/insurance service (non-life insurance) is delivered at a distance to clients beyond the locality and across borders; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Non-life insurers are on the same charter-and-reserve regime, and the industry has been consolidating into a shrinking set of national carriers. Provincial establishments are their branches.

rationale: Financial/insurance service (reinsurance) is delivered at a distance to clients beyond the locality and across borders; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Reinsurance is a national and cross-border business conducted by licensed reinsurers and, in Ecuador, largely by foreign carriers through local representation. No province can enter it.

rationale: Financial/insurance service (pension funding) is delivered at a distance to clients beyond the locality and across borders; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Complementary pension funds — compulsory social security is 8430 — are constituted and run by licensed fund administrators; a provincial booking is a plan's registered address, not a local industry.

rationale: Financial/insurance service (administration of financial markets) is delivered at a distance to clients beyond the locality and across borders; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Ecuador has two authorised stock exchanges, in Quito and Guayaquil. Market administration is a licensed national function and no province can acquire an exchange.

rationale: Financial/insurance service (security and commodity contracts brokerage) is delivered at a distance to clients beyond the locality and across borders; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Securities brokerage requires a casa de valores licence plus exchange membership — roughly thirty of them, all domiciled in Quito and Guayaquil. mixed_entry because the class also contains bureaux de change, an ordinary small private business.

isic_name: Other activities auxiliary to financial service activities
rationale: Financial/insurance service (other activities auxiliary to financial service activities) is delivered at a distance to clients beyond the locality and across borders; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Investment advice, mortgage broking and fiduciary services on a fee basis are professional work a qualified firm can set up anywhere. mixed_entry because the class also holds card acquiring and transaction settlement, which in Ecuador is a bank-owned national duopoly (Datafast, Medianet) no entrant can replicate.

rationale: Financial/insurance service (risk and damage evaluation) is delivered at a distance to clients beyond the locality and across borders; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Loss adjusting and risk evaluation is professional work: registered peritos and ajustadores set up as small firms in any province where there are claims to assess.

isic_name: Activities of insurance agents and brokers
rationale: Financial/insurance service (activities of insurance agents and brokers) is delivered at a distance to clients beyond the locality and across borders; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Insurance broking is contestable and locally owned — hundreds of authorised brokers operate across the provinces. Authorisation by the supervisor is competence screening; being supervised is not the same as entry being allocated through a national network.

isic_name: Other activities auxiliary to insurance and pension funding
rationale: Financial/insurance service (other activities auxiliary to insurance and pension funding) is delivered at a distance to clients beyond the locality and across borders; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Auxiliary insurance services — claims administration, medical-network management, actuarial support — are fee-based professional businesses entered freely.

rationale: Financial/insurance service (fund management activities) is delivered at a distance to clients beyond the locality and across borders; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Fund management is reserved to licensed administradoras de fondos, a nationally authorised and Quito- and Guayaquil-concentrated set; a province cannot host one by wanting to.

isic_name: Real estate activities with own or leased property
rationale: Income from owning/renting property is tied to a fixed location and a local market (non-tradable Atlas); mixed regionally because commercial/portfolio landlords can draw tenants/investors from beyond the locality.
rationale_entry: Real estate (Real estate activities with own or leased property) is entered privately: buying, developing, letting or brokering property needs capital and a municipal permit, not an allocated licence.

isic_name: Real estate activities on a fee or contract basis
rationale: Brokerage/property-management services attach to local property and are mostly non-tradable, though commercial brokerage can serve buyers/investors from other regions and abroad -- mixed under both.
rationale_entry: Real estate (Real estate activities on a fee or contract basis) is entered privately: buying, developing, letting or brokering property needs capital and a municipal permit, not an allocated licence.

rationale: Professional/scientific/technical service (legal activities) can be delivered to remote clients in other provinces and abroad; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Professional and technical services (Legal activities) are contestable: a qualified professional or firm can set up in any province. Professional registration and the colegios supervise practice — being supervised is not the same as entry being allocated.

isic_name: Accounting, bookkeeping and auditing activities; tax consultancy
rationale: Professional/scientific/technical service (accounting, bookkeeping and auditing activities; tax consultancy) can be delivered to remote clients in other provinces and abroad; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Professional and technical services (Accounting, bookkeeping and auditing activities; tax consultancy) are contestable: a qualified professional or firm can set up in any province. Professional registration and the colegios supervise practice — being supervised is not the same as entry being allocated.

rationale: Atlas: head-office services can be billed across borders, tradable. Regional: manual override (Santiago, 2026-08-25) — a head office is not a productive activity a province can recruit or export; its recorded presence is an HQ-booking artifact (the class concentrates the repo's documented HQ/subsidiary booking problem), so regional presence signals are administrative, not economic. Reclassified non-tradable to exclude it from the regional tradable menu.
rationale_entry: A head office sits where the group decides to put it — a private corporate choice. It is an HQ artifact rather than a productive industry, but nothing about its location is allocated.

rationale: Professional/scientific/technical service (management consultancy activities) can be delivered to remote clients in other provinces and abroad; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Professional and technical services (Management consultancy activities) are contestable: a qualified professional or firm can set up in any province. Professional registration and the colegios supervise practice — being supervised is not the same as entry being allocated.

isic_name: Architectural and engineering activities and related technical consultancy
rationale: Professional/scientific/technical service (architectural and engineering activities and related technical consultancy) can be delivered to remote clients in other provinces and abroad; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Professional and technical services (Architectural and engineering activities and related technical consultancy) are contestable: a qualified professional or firm can set up in any province. Professional registration and the colegios supervise practice — being supervised is not the same as entry being allocated.

rationale: Professional/scientific/technical service (technical testing and analysis) can be delivered to remote clients in other provinces and abroad; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Professional and technical services (Technical testing and analysis) are contestable: a qualified professional or firm can set up in any province. Professional registration and the colegios supervise practice — being supervised is not the same as entry being allocated.

isic_name: Research and experimental development on natural sciences and engineering
rationale: Professional/scientific/technical service (research and experimental development on natural sciences and engineering) can be delivered to remote clients in other provinces and abroad; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Corporate and consulting R&D in agriculture, aquaculture and engineering is genuinely private and entered by hiring researchers. mixed_entry because Ecuador's natural-science research capacity is dominated by public institutions whose siting is a ministry decision — INIAP's experimental stations, the public universities' labs, and the Yachay and Ikiam campuses created by executive act.

isic_name: Research and experimental development on social sciences and humanities
rationale: Professional/scientific/technical service (research and experimental development on social sciences and humanities) can be delivered to remote clients in other provinces and abroad; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Social-science and humanities research is carried out by private think tanks, consultancies and foundations that any group may form; the public institutes are a minority of the establishments.

rationale: Professional/scientific/technical service (advertising) can be delivered to remote clients in other provinces and abroad; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Professional and technical services (Advertising) are contestable: a qualified professional or firm can set up in any province. Professional registration and the colegios supervise practice — being supervised is not the same as entry being allocated.

isic_name: Market research and public opinion polling
rationale: Professional/scientific/technical service (market research and public opinion polling) can be delivered to remote clients in other provinces and abroad; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Professional and technical services (Market research and public opinion polling) are contestable: a qualified professional or firm can set up in any province. Professional registration and the colegios supervise practice — being supervised is not the same as entry being allocated.

rationale: Professional/scientific/technical service (specialized design activities) can be delivered to remote clients in other provinces and abroad; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Professional and technical services (Specialized design activities) are contestable: a qualified professional or firm can set up in any province. Professional registration and the colegios supervise practice — being supervised is not the same as entry being allocated.

rationale: Dominated by local consumer services (portrait, event, ID photography); leans non-tradable, though commercial/press photography can serve clients elsewhere -- mixed under both, low confidence.
rationale_entry: Professional and technical services (Photographic activities) are contestable: a qualified professional or firm can set up in any province. Professional registration and the colegios supervise practice — being supervised is not the same as entry being allocated.

isic_name: Other professional, scientific and technical activities n.e.c.
rationale: Professional/scientific/technical service (other professional, scientific and technical activities n.e.c.) can be delivered to remote clients in other provinces and abroad; tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Professional and technical services (Other professional, scientific and technical activities n.e.c.) are contestable: a qualified professional or firm can set up in any province. Professional registration and the colegios supervise practice — being supervised is not the same as entry being allocated.

rationale: Veterinary services are delivered on-site to local pet owners and farms (non-tradable Atlas), but livestock/animal-health practices serve a regional agricultural catchment (tradable regional). Divergence; mixed.
rationale_entry: Professional and technical services (Veterinary activities) are contestable: a qualified professional or firm can set up in any province. Professional registration and the colegios supervise practice — being supervised is not the same as entry being allocated.

isic_name: Renting and leasing of motor vehicles
rationale: Vehicle rental serves travellers and regional business clients (airport rental partly serves inbound visitors), but is largely a domestic service; non-tradable Atlas (mixed), tradable regional. Divergence; mixed.
rationale_entry: Administrative and support services (Renting and leasing of motor vehicles) are entered by forming a firm and winning contracts; sectoral permits (Ministerio del Interior for guarding, ANT for driver services) license conduct, not the number of entrants per province.

isic_name: Renting and leasing of recreational and sports goods
rationale: Consumer recreational/sports-goods rental serves local users (some tourist rental); non-tradable Atlas, mixed/leaning local regionally.
rationale_entry: Administrative and support services (Renting and leasing of recreational and sports goods) are entered by forming a firm and winning contracts; sectoral permits (Ministerio del Interior for guarding, ANT for driver services) license conduct, not the number of entrants per province.

isic_name: Renting of video tapes and disks
rationale: Local consumer video rental outlets; non-tradable under both.
rationale_entry: Administrative and support services (Renting of video tapes and disks) are entered by forming a firm and winning contracts; sectoral permits (Ministerio del Interior for guarding, ANT for driver services) license conduct, not the number of entrants per province.

isic_name: Renting and leasing of other personal and household goods
rationale: Consumer/household-goods rental serving local users; non-tradable Atlas, mildly mixed regionally.
rationale_entry: Administrative and support services (Renting and leasing of other personal and household goods) are entered by forming a firm and winning contracts; sectoral permits (Ministerio del Interior for guarding, ANT for driver services) license conduct, not the number of entrants per province.

isic_name: Renting and leasing of other machinery, equipment and tangible goods
rationale: Plant/equipment rental (construction, industrial machinery) serves business clients across a region (tradable regional) but is not an exported service (non-tradable Atlas). Divergence; mixed.
rationale_entry: Administrative and support services (Renting and leasing of other machinery, equipment and tangible goods) are entered by forming a firm and winning contracts; sectoral permits (Ministerio del Interior for guarding, ANT for driver services) license conduct, not the number of entrants per province.

isic_name: Leasing of intellectual property and similar products, except copyrighted works
rationale: Licensing of patents, trademarks and franchises generates royalties that flow across regions and borders; tradable under both. Mixed under Atlas given heterogeneity.
rationale_entry: Administrative and support services (Leasing of intellectual property and similar products, except copyrighted works) are entered by forming a firm and winning contracts; sectoral permits (Ministerio del Interior for guarding, ANT for driver services) license conduct, not the number of entrants per province.

rationale: Recruitment/placement serves employers and job-seekers across a region/nation (tradable regional), but the core matching is largely a domestic labour-market service (non-tradable Atlas); mixed, some cross-border recruitment.
rationale_entry: Administrative and support services (Activities of employment placement agencies) are entered by forming a firm and winning contracts; sectoral permits (Ministerio del Interior for guarding, ANT for driver services) license conduct, not the number of entrants per province.

rationale: Manual Ecuador review override (2026-08-17): Mandato Constituyente 8 (2008) constitutionally banned labour intermediation — supplying agency-employed workers to client firms — so the activity barely legally exists in Ecuador. What survives (complementary services: cleaning, security, catering) is delivered on-site with locally hired staff. Non-tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Labour intermediation was constitutionally banned by Mandato Constituyente 8 (2008), so there is very little lawful activity to enter — but the binding constraint is prohibition, not allocation: nothing about the surviving complementary-services business is sited or licensed by the state.

rationale: Manual Ecuador review override (2026-08-17): employer-of-record / PEO provision is precisely the tercerizacion prohibited by Mandato Constituyente 8 (2008); there is no lawful Ecuadorian market in which this service could be sold across provinces. Non-tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Employer-of-record provision is the tercerizacion prohibited by Mandato 8 (2008). As with 7820 the constraint is a ban rather than an allocation, so the class is labelled open-market even though the market is largely closed by law.

rationale: Travel agencies earn commissions serving travellers; inbound/tour bookings are part of exported tourism services; tradable under both.
rationale_entry: Administrative and support services (Travel agency activities) are entered by forming a firm and winning contracts; sectoral permits (Ministerio del Interior for guarding, ANT for driver services) license conduct, not the number of entrants per province.

rationale: Tour operators package and sell destination experiences to visitors from other regions and abroad -- a core exported tourism service; tradable under both.
rationale_entry: Administrative and support services (Tour operator activities) are entered by forming a firm and winning contracts; sectoral permits (Ministerio del Interior for guarding, ANT for driver services) license conduct, not the number of entrants per province.

rationale: Reservation/ticketing and related services support travel and tourism flows; tradable under both, mixed under Atlas given some local activity.
rationale_entry: Administrative and support services (Other reservation service and related activities) are entered by forming a firm and winning contracts; sectoral permits (Ministerio del Interior for guarding, ANT for driver services) license conduct, not the number of entrants per province.

rationale: Guarding services are delivered at the client's local premises; mostly non-tradable, though firms can hold multi-province contracts -- mixed regionally.

rationale: Alarm monitoring/installation can run from a regional/national centre (straddles) but ultimately serves local premises; mixed under both, leaning local.
rationale_entry: Administrative and support services (Security systems service activities) are entered by forming a firm and winning contracts; sectoral permits (Ministerio del Interior for guarding, ANT for driver services) license conduct, not the number of entrants per province.

rationale: Private investigation serves mostly local/regional clients and can occasionally serve clients elsewhere; mixed, leaning non-tradable.
rationale_entry: Administrative and support services (Investigation activities) are entered by forming a firm and winning contracts; sectoral permits (Ministerio del Interior for guarding, ANT for driver services) license conduct, not the number of entrants per province.

rationale: Manual Ecuador review override (2026-08-17): facilities-support contracts are executed on the client's premises with staff hired where the client sits, so a host province captures only HQ overhead — and those HQs already sit in Quito/Guayaquil. rationale_entry: Administrative and support services (Combined facilities support activities) are entered by forming a firm and winning contracts; sectoral permits (Ministerio del Interior for guarding, ANT for driver services) license conduct, not the number of entrants per province.

rationale: Building cleaning is performed on-site for local clients -- a ubiquitous local service; non-tradable under both.

rationale: Call/contact centres are classic business-process outsourcing serving clients in other regions and abroad -- internationally tradable; tradable under both.

isic_name: Activities of collection agencies and credit bureaus
rationale: Debt-collection and credit-reference services can be centralised and serve clients across a region/nation (tradable regional); not typically exported (non-tradable Atlas). Mixed.
rationale_entry: Debt collection is an ordinary private service. The credit-bureau side is a licensed national duopoly (Equifax Ecuador, Aval Buro), but collection agencies — the bulk of the establishments — are formed freely.

rationale: Contract packing/labelling supports manufacturers and exporters and can serve clients across a region (tradable regional); the service itself is not exported (non-tradable Atlas). Divergence; mixed.
rationale_entry: Administrative and support services (Packaging activities) are entered by forming a firm and winning contracts; sectoral permits (Ministerio del Interior for guarding, ANT for driver services) license conduct, not the number of entrants per province.

isic_name: Other business support service activities n.e.c.
rationale: Manual Ecuador review override (2026-08-17): the class's dominant Ecuadorian contents — court reporting, repossession, coin collection, local auctioneers, miscellaneous office support — serve strictly local clients. The national-reach niches (bar-code administration via GS1 Ecuador, loyalty-program administrators) amount to one or two Quito/Guayaquil entities, not an industry a province can sell outward. Non-tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Administrative and support services (Other business support service activities n.e.c.) are entered by forming a firm and winning contracts; sectoral permits (Ministerio del Interior for guarding, ANT for driver services) license conduct, not the number of entrants per province.

rationale: Local schooling for resident children; non-tradable under both (anchor: primary/secondary excluded).
rationale_entry: Basic education is overwhelmingly public in Ecuador and its geography is the Ministerio de Educacion's: districts, circuits and the Unidades Educativas del Milenio are placed by national planning. Private schools exist but also require ministry authorisation per district, so even they are permitted rather than simply opened.

rationale: Secondary schooling serves the resident population locally; non-tradable under both.
rationale_entry: General secondary education is on the same footing as primary: the ministry's district planning decides where schools are, and private provision is authorised school by school.

rationale: Vocational/technical schools mostly serve local students, but some specialized institutes draw a regional catchment; non-tradable Atlas, mixed regionally.
rationale_entry: Technical and vocational secondary schooling is a ministry programme — bachillerato tecnico offerings are assigned to institutions by the Ministerio de Educacion — so its provincial presence is a curriculum and budget decision.

rationale: Universities draw students from across the country (and some international students) -- strongly region-serving (tradable regional) and partly an exported service (mixed Atlas); routine teaching is local. Canonical Atlas-vs-regional divergence (anchor): non-tradable Atlas, tradable regional.
rationale_entry: Universities in Ecuador are created by law: the Asamblea Nacional charters them on CES and CACES evaluation, 14 were closed by state decision in 2012, and the newest ones (Yachay, Ikiam, UNAE, UArtes) were placed by executive choice. Public institutions dominate enrolment, extensions require CES authorisation, and no province can obtain a university through private investment.

rationale: Driving schools and sports/recreation instruction mostly serve local learners; some academies draw regionally -- non-tradable, mixed.
rationale_entry: Sports academies, football schools and instruction camps are private businesses entered with a coach and a pitch.

rationale: Music/art/language tuition mostly serves local learners; specialized academies can draw regionally -- non-tradable, mixed.
rationale_entry: Music, dance, art and drama studios are private, non-degree instruction — opened freely wherever there are pupils.

rationale: Includes language schools, exam prep and online courses that can serve students elsewhere (tradable regional, partly Atlas), but much is local tuition; mixed/low confidence.
rationale_entry: Language schools, computer academies, driving schools and adult training are private businesses; the ANT authorisation a driving school needs is conduct regulation, not an allocated slot.

rationale: Manual Ecuador review override (2026-08-17): educational counseling, test-prep/evaluation and exchange-program agencies sell to resident families and local schools; the institution-facing consulting market is thin and centres on Ministry contracts in Quito. No realistic channel exists for a typical province to sell educational-support services outward. Non-tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Educational consulting, testing and exchange-programme agencies are private service firms. The largest single buyer is the ministry, but the firms themselves are formed freely.

section_name: Human health and social work activities
rationale: Referral and specialized hospitals draw patients from many provinces (tradable regional) and attract some medical tourism (mixed Atlas); routine hospital care is local. Canonical Atlas-vs-regional divergence (anchor): non-tradable Atlas, tradable regional.
rationale_entry: Where a hospital is, in Ecuador, is a Ministerio de Salud Publica or IESS investment decision: the public network is planned and budgeted nationally, and it is what makes this the single most-recommended class in the measured evidence. mixed_entry because private clinics and hospitals (Metropolitano, Kennedy, Hospital del Rio) are numerous, capital-financed and genuinely entered — so the class straddles, but its establishment mass and its siting logic are public.

section_name: Human health and social work activities
rationale: Routine medical/dental practice serves local patients (non-tradable), but specialist consultants and dental/medical tourism draw a wider catchment; mixed under both, leaning local.
rationale_entry: Medical and dental practice is the contestable core of Ecuadorian health care: consultorios and small clinics opened by professionals with an ARCSA permit, and by far the largest establishment count in section Q.

section_name: Human health and social work activities
rationale: Diagnostic labs, imaging and ambulance services often operate from regional hubs serving multiple provinces (tradable regional) but are not generally exported (non-tradable Atlas); mixed.
rationale_entry: Laboratories, imaging centres, ambulance services and outpatient therapy are private capital-financed businesses entered with equipment and a health permit.

section_name: Human health and social work activities
rationale: Residential nursing care mainly serves the local/regional population; some specialized facilities draw a wider catchment -- non-tradable, mixed regionally.
rationale_entry: Nursing homes and convalescent facilities in Ecuador are largely private and church-run; entry is a building and a health permit.

isic_name: Residential care activities for mental retardation, mental health and substance abuse
section_name: Human health and social work activities
rationale: Specialized residential mental-health/substance-abuse care can serve a regional catchment but is largely place-bound social care; non-tradable, mixed regionally.
rationale_entry: Residential treatment for addiction and mental health is a mostly private sector in Ecuador (the licensed CETAD network), entered with premises and an MSP licence.

isic_name: Residential care activities for the elderly and disabled
section_name: Human health and social work activities
rationale: Care homes serve mostly local/regional residents; non-tradable Atlas, mildly mixed regionally.
rationale_entry: Assisted living and homes for the elderly are opened privately with an MSP permit. mixed_entry because much of the sector operates on MIES convenios — state funding agreements that decide where a facility is viable — so the money, and effectively the siting, is public even where the operator is not.

section_name: Human health and social work activities
rationale: Residential social care, largely local/regional; non-tradable, mixed regionally.
rationale_entry: Orphanages, shelters and children's homes are run by NGOs, foundations and the church, which may be established freely; state funding shapes viability but the entrant is private.

isic_name: Social work activities without accommodation for the elderly and disabled
section_name: Human health and social work activities
rationale: Community social services for local residents; non-tradable under both.
rationale_entry: Day care and counselling for the elderly and disabled is delivered mostly by foundations and NGOs on MIES convenios; forming the organisation is a private act even though the programme money is public.

isic_name: Other social work activities without accommodation
section_name: Human health and social work activities
rationale: Local community/social assistance services; non-tradable under both.
rationale_entry: Family counselling, child protection and community social work are carried out by freely constituted foundations and NGOs alongside public programmes.

rationale: Artists, performers and producers create works and shows that tour and sell beyond the locality (and can be exported); leans tradable under both, mixed given some purely local performance.
rationale_entry: Arts, sport and recreation (Creative, arts and entertainment activities) is a private and associative business — performers, promoters, clubs and venues formed freely and following audiences. Public cultural institutions exist alongside them but do not gate entry.

rationale: Public libraries/archives serve the local resident population; non-tradable under both.
rationale_entry: Libraries and archives in Ecuador are public institutions — municipal libraries, the Archivo Nacional, the Casa de la Cultura's collections — placed by budget decision. There is no private library industry to enter.

isic_name: Museums activities and operation of historical sites and buildings
rationale: Museums and heritage sites attract visitors from other regions and abroad (cultural tourism); tradable under both, mixed under Atlas for small local museums.
rationale_entry: Museums here are overwhelmingly public: the Ministerio de Cultura's institutions, municipal museums, and the Casa de la Cultura Ecuatoriana, which holds a nucleo in every province by statute. Private museums exist but are a handful, and a heritage site is where history left it.

isic_name: Botanical and zoological gardens and nature reserves activities
rationale: Gardens, zoos and nature reserves are tourism draws pulling visitors from elsewhere (highly relevant for Ecuador); tradable under both, mixed under Atlas where attendance is local.
rationale_entry: The nature-reserve half of this class is the Sistema Nacional de Areas Protegidas — declared and managed by MAATE, an act of state. mixed_entry because zoos, botanical gardens and private bosques protectores are entered by municipalities and private foundations, so the class holds a genuinely enterable component.

rationale: Manual Ecuador review override (2026-08-17): the 2011 referendum banned casinos and gaming halls (closed by 2012), eliminating the visiting-patron channel. What remains domestically is lottery-ticket distribution (Junta de Beneficencia network) — local retail — while online sports betting runs on foreign-domiciled platforms. Non-tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: The 2011 referendum banned casinos and gaming halls, which closed in 2012, and what survives domestically is the Junta de Beneficencia de Guayaquil's legally sanctioned lottery; online betting runs on foreign platforms. Neither prohibition nor a statutory monopoly is a channel a private entrant can use.

rationale: Sports facilities mostly serve local users, but stadiums hosting regional/national events draw wider audiences -- non-tradable, mixed regionally.
rationale_entry: Gyms, courts, pools and pitches operated commercially are ordinary private businesses; the municipal stadiums in the class are a minority of establishments.

rationale: Most clubs serve local members; professional clubs draw regional/national fan revenue and transfers -- mixed, leaning local.
rationale_entry: Sports clubs are privately constituted associations and companies, football clubs included. The provincial sports federations are statutory bodies but they are few.

rationale: Mostly local sports provision (instructors, leagues); some professional/event activity draws wider audiences -- non-tradable, mixed.
rationale_entry: Arts, sport and recreation (Other sports activities) is a private and associative business — performers, promoters, clubs and venues formed freely and following audiences. Public cultural institutions exist alongside them but do not gate entry.

isic_name: Activities of amusement parks and theme parks
rationale: Amusement/theme parks attract visitors travelling from other regions (and tourists); tradable under both, mixed under Atlas where attendance is mostly local.
rationale_entry: Arts, sport and recreation (Activities of amusement parks and theme parks) is a private and associative business — performers, promoters, clubs and venues formed freely and following audiences. Public cultural institutions exist alongside them but do not gate entry.

isic_name: Other amusement and recreation activities n.e.c.
rationale: Mostly local recreation services; some attractions draw a regional/tourist catchment -- non-tradable, mixed.
rationale_entry: Arts, sport and recreation (Other amusement and recreation activities n.e.c.) is a private and associative business — performers, promoters, clubs and venues formed freely and following audiences. Public cultural institutions exist alongside them but do not gate entry.

isic_name: Activities of business and employers membership organizations
rationale: Membership organization (activities of business and employers membership organizations) serves its members and advocacy/community functions, not a market output sold across regions; non-tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Repair, personal and membership services (Activities of business and employers membership organizations) are entered by private decision — a workshop, a salon or an act of association. Nothing about presence is allocated from above.

rationale: Membership organization (activities of professional membership organizations) serves its members and advocacy/community functions, not a market output sold across regions; non-tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Professional membership organisations include the statutory colegios profesionales, established province by province in law, but forming a professional association is a private act of association and the class as a whole is entered rather than allocated.

rationale: Membership organization (activities of trade unions) serves its members and advocacy/community functions, not a market output sold across regions; non-tradable under both definitions.

rationale_entry: Repair, personal and membership services (Activities of religious organizations) are entered by private decision — a workshop, a salon or an act of association. Nothing about presence is allocated from above.

rationale: Membership organization (activities of political organizations) serves its members and advocacy/community functions, not a market output sold across regions; non-tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Political organisations are formed by private association and registered with the CNE on meeting national thresholds; presence in a province is a political decision by their own members, not a state siting one.

isic_name: Activities of other membership organizations n.e.c.
rationale: Membership organization (activities of other membership organizations n.e.c.) serves its members and advocacy/community functions, not a market output sold across regions; non-tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Repair, personal and membership services (Activities of other membership organizations n.e.c.) are entered by private decision — a workshop, a salon or an act of association. Nothing about presence is allocated from above.

isic_name: Repair of computers and peripheral equipment
rationale: Manual Ecuador review override (2026-08-17): dominated by walk-in shops serving their own city; the ship-in warranty/service-centre niche is a handful of authorized centres in Quito/Guayaquil. Neighbourhood repair is exactly the local-service category the regional definition excludes. Non-tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Repair, personal and membership services (Repair of computers and peripheral equipment) are entered by private decision — a workshop, a salon or an act of association. Nothing about presence is allocated from above.

rationale: Manual Ecuador review override (2026-08-17): overwhelmingly mall-kiosk cell-phone repair for local walk-ins; carrier transmission equipment is serviced by telecom operators' own contractors or shipped abroad on manufacturer RMA. Not a provincial industry selling across provinces — non-tradable under both definitions.
rationale_entry: Repair, personal and membership services (Repair of communication equipment) are entered by private decision — a workshop, a salon or an act of association. Nothing about presence is allocated from above.

rationale: Local consumer-electronics repair; non-tradable Atlas, mildly mixed regionally.
rationale_entry: Repair, personal and membership services (Repair of consumer electronics) are entered by private decision — a workshop, a salon or an act of association. Nothing about presence is allocated from above.

rationale_entry: Repair, personal and membership services (Repair of other personal and household goods) are entered by private decision — a workshop, a salon or an act of association. Nothing about presence is allocated from above.

rationale_entry: Repair, personal and membership services (Washing and (dry-) cleaning of textile and fur products) are entered by private decision — a workshop, a salon or an act of association. Nothing about presence is allocated from above.

rationale: Personal grooming delivered in person to local clients -- the archetypal non-tradable local service (anchor); non-tradable under both.
rationale_entry: Repair, personal and membership services (Hairdressing and other beauty treatment) are entered by private decision — a workshop, a salon or an act of association. Nothing about presence is allocated from above.

rationale: Funeral services serve the local community; non-tradable under both.
rationale_entry: Funeral homes, crematoria and funeral-insurance businesses are private and freely entered; municipal cemeteries are the public minority of the class.

rationale: Personal services (spas, tattooing, etc.) delivered in person to local clients; non-tradable under both.
rationale_entry: Repair, personal and membership services (Other personal service activities n.e.c.) are entered by private decision — a workshop, a salon or an act of association. Nothing about presence is allocated from above.

isic_name: Activities of households as employers of domestic personnel
section_name: Activities of households as employers; undifferentiated goods- and services-producing activities of households for own use
rationale: Domestic staff employed by and serving a household; not a market-traded output; non-tradable under both.
rationale_entry: Households as employers (Activities of households as employers of domestic personnel) is a statistical residual, not a firm-entry industry: the 'entrant' is a household hiring domestic help, a private decision. Labelled open-market because no state or network allocation is involved, but it is never a diversification target.

isic_name: Undifferentiated goods-producing activities of private households for own use
section_name: Activities of households as employers; undifferentiated goods- and services-producing activities of households for own use
rationale: Subsistence own-use goods production by households; not marketed; non-tradable under both.
rationale_entry: Households as employers (Undifferentiated goods-producing activities of private households for own use) is a statistical residual, not a firm-entry industry: the 'entrant' is a household hiring domestic help, a private decision. isic_name: Activities of extraterritorial organizations and bodies
section_name: Activities of extraterritorial organizations and bodies
rationale: Embassies and international organizations perform diplomatic/administrative functions rather than producing a market-traded output; non-tradable under both, though their local spending behaves somewhat like an external demand injection. Sui generis; mixed/low confidence.
rationale_entry: Extraterritorial bodies (Activities of extraterritorial organizations and bodies) — embassies, UN and multilateral offices — are placed by foreign governments and international organisations, overwhelmingly in Quito. Presence is a diplomatic decision, not a market one.

isic_name: Design and development of blockchain-based solutions
rationale: Blockchain software design/development is a digital IT service delivered at a distance to clients in other provinces and abroad; tradable under both definitions (mirrors ISIC 6201/6209).
rationale_entry: Information and content services (Design and development of blockchain-based solutions) need no licence and no allocated frequency: a studio, a newsroom or a software team is set up with people and equipment, and the output travels over networks the firm does not have to own.

rationale: Management of virtual/crypto assets is a financial service delivered remotely to clients beyond the locality and across borders; tradable under both. Mixed under Atlas given the novelty/heterogeneity of the activity.
rationale_entry: This financial activity (Virtual asset management) is not a chartered intermediation business: it can be carried on by an ordinary company, so a province gains it when a firm chooses to operate there.

isic_name: Advisory, management and operation services for virtual markets
rationale: Advising on and operating virtual markets is a financial/technical service delivered at a distance to clients across regions and borders; tradable under both. Mixed under Atlas given the activity's novelty.
rationale_entry: This financial activity (Advisory, management and operation services for virtual markets) is not a chartered intermediation business: it can be carried on by an ordinary company, so a province gains it when a firm chooses to operate there.
